hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.status: Shin2022 participants are independent of HS-Stroke and Lee2019; the release was analysed by Paper A at benchmark level (LEAKED/PLACEBO/CLEAN); no trial-level identity-swap outcome on it exists. Natural duplicates.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2: d_EEGNet > 0 (EEGNet-8,2, kern 125 at 250 Hz, mean over 20 CRN seeds)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H3: d_EEGNet > d_TSLR on the same pairs (direction observed on HS-Stroke and confirmed on Lee2019)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H4_law: one-Newton-step prediction from the base model: ratio in [0.8, 1.25] and pair-level r >= 0.9
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.descriptive: placebo per model, BA contrast, context probability, near/far trial-position strata, A/A determinism
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold
